'''M-78 The Harvester''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] located on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[3643 BBY]], when it was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
M-78 The Harvester appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Hutta. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
